resources.string: Experimental, read-only CGM monitoring. No insulin delivery or pump-setting changes. Use your pump and established glucose monitoring for treatment and alarms.

Start read-only pump pairing and automatic watch sharing? Insulin delivery is not changed. Local Bluetooth sharing is unencrypted and unauthenticated; nearby devices may read or imitate readings.\n\nContinue only when no other pump phone app is connected. Start here, then select this phone in the pump\'s mobile-device pairing menu. Select GlucoStride on the watch.

Remove this app\'s encrypted pairing record? This does not remove Android Bluetooth bonds, erase pump data, or send an unpair/settings command to the pump. You may need to remove the old mobile pairing on the pump before pairing again.
Stop the pump and watch before forgetting local pairing.
Could not clear the saved pump diagnostic.
No current reading — connect the pump to start.
Stopping pump and watch — no current reading.
No glucose yet — waiting for a complete pump CGM read.
none since start, or source interrupted
Last complete read: %1$s\nCompleted records this session: %2$d
Read-only pump monitoring and automatic watch sharing. Open for reading and connection status. No glucose values in notifications.
Select GlucoStride on your watch. Sharing starts with the pump; Stop ends both. Local Bluetooth is unencrypted: nearby devices may read or imitate readings.
Latest prepared packet: %1$s\nConfirmed BLE sends: %2$d · Last: %3$s\nSend confirmation does not verify the watch display.
Pump and watch could not start. Keep the app open, check Bluetooth, then try again.
Could not send Stop. Keep the app open and try again.

Pairing or a Bluetooth connection does not confirm a glucose reading. Completed records count complete pump reads, including repeated or rejected samples; they are not a count of distinct valid readings.\n\nA watch subscription does not confirm glucose delivery. Confirmed BLE sends count successful Android send callbacks, including packets without glucose. The latest prepared packet may not be the last one sent. Neither confirms that the watch displays a reading. Compare the displayed value and sample time on the phone, pump and watch.

Optional comparison mode, off by default. After Android bonding, request balanced Bluetooth link parameters before pump authentication. The pump may reject or ignore the request. No MTU, therapy or pump-data changes. Change only while stopped; your selection is remembered.
No Android battery restriction detected. Screen-off operation still needs checking.
Android battery status could not be checked. See battery help.
Battery Saver is on and may interrupt background Bluetooth. Turn it off in Android battery settings.
Android restricts this app in the background. Open app settings and set Battery to Unrestricted.
Battery optimization is enabled for this app and may interrupt screen-off readings. In app settings, choose Battery → Unrestricted if available.

On Samsung: Settings → Apps → GlucoStride → Battery → Unrestricted. Under Settings → Battery (or Battery and device care → Battery) → Background usage limits, remove GlucoStride from Sleeping apps and Deep sleeping apps. Menu names vary by Android version.

Turn off Battery Saver / Power saving when testing background operation. These choices can increase battery use; this app does not change them automatically.

After changing settings, connect the pump, turn the phone screen off for several minutes, then compare the phone and watch readings and source sample times with the pump. A connection or subscription alone does not prove readings continue. Android cannot report every manufacturer-specific sleep rule.
Android app settings could not be opened. Open Settings → Apps → GlucoStride manually, then check Battery and Notifications.

Notifications are disabled. Open Android app settings → Notifications and enable them so the ongoing pump/watch notification and Stop action are visible. Monitoring may still run while notifications are hidden.
Nearby devices permission is required for the pump and watch. Grant it here, or open Android app settings → Permissions → Nearby devices.
Turn on Bluetooth, then connect the pump and watch.
This phone has no Bluetooth adapter.

GlucoStride Android pump reader: GPL-3.0-only. Includes adaptations of the GlycemicGPT unofficial Android Medtronic driver and OpenMinimed protocol implementations. SAKE is provided by OpenMinimed JavaSake (GPL-3.0); cryptographic primitives by the Legion of the Bouncy Castle (MIT). The project includes source provenance and license notices. No warranty; no claim of medical-device approval.
